title: LandNiedererBatched omits resting-calcium preconditioning
evidence: The scalar paired model conditions states for nonzero resting Cai to prevent a documented spurious tension transient; the batched class inherits the base no-op and starts from raw Cai=0 prototype states.
canonical_reference: LandNiederer::preconditionToRestingState and sequentialElectroMechanical constructor hook at lines 87-95
impact: Batched electromechanics can begin from the wrong physical state and produce a global early tension/deformation transient.
proposed_fix: Implement equivalent configurable batched preconditioning only after capturing scalar resting-state behavior and approving tolerances/baseline changes.
notes: Repaired after explicit maintainer approval. LandNiedererBatched now applies configurable resting-Cai preconditioning through the existing batched integration hot path, uniformly scatters the conditioned representative state, clears transient data, and resets stretch history. Generated-RHS convergence and step-refinement tests pass; sourced OpenFOAM scalar/batched, OpenMP/CUDA, and full electromechanical reference validation remain pending.

title: Nested ownership of one pimpleControl loop consumes strong-coupling correctors
evidence: The orchestration layer calls loop() around coupling and domain advances, then both implicit kernels call loop() again on the identical pimpleControl. Official OpenFOAM v2512 pimpleControl::loop increments the shared corr_ on every call and resets it when nCorrPIMPLE is exhausted, so inner calls consume correctors without refreshing coupling.
canonical_reference: OpenFOAM v2512 pimpleControl.C lines 200-264 and standard single-owner PIMPLE-loop usage; cardiacFoam's pimpleStaggered scheme describes strong coupling at the orchestration layer.
impact: Requested outer correctors after the first can become diffusion-only iterations, so conduction and PVJ coupling are not refreshed as advertised and coupled numerical results can be wrong.
proposed_fix: Make the orchestration scheme the sole owner of pimple.loop() and make the kernel overload execute exactly one implicit diffusion solve per corrector.
tests: Exact call-count regression for 1, 2, and 3 outer correctors
notes: Upgraded from investigation after checking the official OpenFOAM v2512 loop implementation. Repair remains deferred because it changes solver ordering and no sourced OpenFOAM numerical-regression environment is available.
